title: 無線區域網路企業部署
summary: 以射頻容量、漫遊與企業身分驗證串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect rf capacity, roaming and enterprise authentication through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 需求與並行數：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Demand and concurrency: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「需求與並行數」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For demand and concurrency, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「需求與並行數」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：使用者數量與同時傳輸的用戶數不同。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留客戶數，只改同頻 AP 數，分析共享 airtime。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「鏈路預算」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around demand and concurrency, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Total users and simultaneously transmitting clients are different counts. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Keep client count and vary co-channel APs to analyze shared airtime. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat link budget as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 保留客戶數，只改同頻 AP 數，分析共享 airtime。 比較「需求與並行數」與「鏈路預算」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Keep client count and vary co-channel APs to analyze shared airtime. Compare whether evidence for demand and concurrency and link budget supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 增加 AP 數一定線性增加同頻容量。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Adding APs always increases co-channel capacity linearly. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「需求與並行數」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for demand and concurrency. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 使用者數量與同時傳輸的用戶數不同。
knowledge.textEn: Total users and simultaneously transmitting clients are different counts.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「鏈路預算」：接收功率由發射、天線增益及路徑損耗共同決定。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「需求與並行數」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring link budget: Receive power combines transmit power, antenna gains and path loss. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove demand and concurrency passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 保留客戶數，只改同頻 AP 數，分析共享 airtime。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Keep client count and vary co-channel APs to analyze shared airtime. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想同頻域 20 台客戶端各需 2 Mbit/s，共 40 Mbit/s；有效吞吐 80 Mbit/s 的負載約 50%。此為平均容量假設，未保證碰撞、漫遊或 p99。
knowledge.textEn: Twenty clients each needing 2 Mbit/s demand 40 Mbit/s; with assumed usable throughput of 80 Mbit/s, load is 50%, without guarantees for collisions, roaming or p99.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「無線區域網路企業部署」的「需求與並行數：架構與原理」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「可信服務：中斷後的交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Demand and concurrency: architecture and principle” in “Enterprise wireless-LAN deployment”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Trusted Service: Handoff After an Outage” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 針對「需求與並行數」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of demand and concurrency?
options: 使用者數量與同時傳輸的用戶數不同。
增加 AP 數一定線性增加同頻容量。
只檢查「鏈路預算」，便可取代「需求與並行數」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Total users and simultaneously transmitting clients are different counts.
Adding APs always increases co-channel capacity linearly.
Checking link budget alone replaces verification specific to demand and concurrency.
quiz.explanation: 使用者數量與同時傳輸的用戶數不同。 相鄰的「鏈路預算」有不同責任：接收功率由發射、天線增益及路徑損耗共同決定。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Total users and simultaneously transmitting clients are different counts. Neighboring link budget has a different role: Receive power combines transmit power, antenna gains and path loss. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 需求與並行數：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Demand and concurrency: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「需求與並行數」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For demand and concurrency, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「使用者數量與同時傳輸的用戶數不同。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：保留客戶數，只改同頻 AP 數，分析共享 airtime。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「鏈路預算」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Total users and simultaneously transmitting clients are different counts. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Keep client count and vary co-channel APs to analyze shared airtime. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from link budget to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 保留客戶數，只改同頻 AP 數，分析共享 airtime。 比較「需求與並行數」與「鏈路預算」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Keep client count and vary co-channel APs to analyze shared airtime. Compare whether evidence for demand and concurrency and link budget supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 增加 AP 數一定線性增加同頻容量。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Adding APs always increases co-channel capacity linearly. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「需求與並行數」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for demand and concurrency. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.
